annotationPrinciples: KnowledgeNode must be the smallest independently teachable, assessable, and reusable knowledge/capability unit.
Chapter, section, lesson, summary, question set, figure, product example, and curriculum container are not KnowledgeNodes merely because they appear in the source.
Document order is not automatically a prerequisite relation.
Only prerequisite, enables, and related are valid Knowledge relation types for this dataset.
Descriptions and mastery criteria are human-authored summaries of the source; they are not verbatim excerpts.
